Featured Manager · Pre-season

A new name in the twelve

mdropkin takes slot 11 and builds Kurt Zouma's Kittens off the ninth pick

The only change to the DPL roll call for 2026/27 is at slot 11, where mdropkin comes in for jacklynch213. In a redraft league that matters less than it might elsewhere — all twelve rosters went back in the box in August and every manager built again from nothing, so the new man is level on assets and behind only on history. He drew the ninth pick, spent it on João Pedro, and doubled back for Declan Rice at 16. From there he leaned Arsenal: Havertz, Tzolis and David Raya all landed on the same roster, with Raya the eighth-round answer in goal. The shape that came out of it is forward-loaded — seven up top, five at the back, four in midfield — and it gets tested immediately. GW1 pairs him with erozier, who won the thing last year.
